warnings: 35 explicitly authored resource placements lie outside procedural spawn filters; native identifiers and broad improvement domains were checked, but the map still needs engine testing.
Engine loading, automatic player placement, AI, dams and disasters have not been tested.
Floodplain features are present, but flood events and dam eligibility require in-game testing; static SQLite checks cannot validate engine river metadata.
Source geometry is simplified at 15.5 km per hex. Tiny islands, lakes and Bay narrows are enlarged; intermittent channels are shown only in the reference overlay.
Coarse-grid flow is oriented toward low drainage endpoints; it is not a hydraulic simulation.
